This year’s zFondo series explores a variety of our longer routes - with a moderate amount of climbing mixed in, bringing together Zwifters looking to take on an epic challenge and push themselves toward new endurance goals.

name: Restart Esports - Happy Hour
description:
Restart Esports - instagram.com/restart.esports

1. Heart Rate Monitor (HRM) is mandatory for all participants.

2. Power Source is Mandatory for all racers. A smart trainer or smart bike should be your power source where possible. ZPower is not allowed. 

3. Dual Recording - Should always be done if you have the capability. All podium positions are expected to dual record or have at least have a recent dual recording history on their profile. Any rider posting high level performances is expected to validate their hardware with dual recordings as a minimum. 

Results WILL be amended (if required), in the interest of fair play, for all Restart Esports hosted events.

eventSubgroups.name: Restart Esports - Happy Hour (A)
eventSubgroups.description:
Join in on a new weekly race: the Restart Racing Sunday Classic.

Restart Racing is an eRacing team that likes to race hard and have fun. eSports gives us an amazing platform to better ourselves as bike racers and is a great way to make friends and enjoy ourselves. 

Each week will feature a different course ranging in distance from 50-70kms with a target finish time of around 1.5hrs. Please use ZwiftPower's Minimum Category on your profile for race entry.

Cats A & B riders require a power source (power meter or smart trainer) plus a heart rate monitor. Podium finishers in Cat A are expected to dual record and make analysis 'Public' on Zwift Power while using a direct drive trainer and power meter.
Cat C will require a power source (power meter or smart trainer) and a heart rate monitor for podium spots.

Cat A - 4.0+ (min 250W)
Cat B - 3.2 - 4.0 w/kg (min 200W)
Cat C - 2.5 - 3.2 w/kg (min 150W)
Cat D - 1.0 - 2.5 w/kg

name: CC Rider | Social 1.8-2.0 W/kg
description:
Welcome to the CC Riders Afternoon Ride!

Join us for a 60-minute D-category social ride targeting 1.8–2.0 W/kg. The ride leader will maintain the advertised effort, although power and speed may vary slightly with the route, terrain, and draft.

There is no rubber banding or event fence. Settle into the group and enjoy the social pace, or continue ahead if your legs are feeling strong. Drafting is enabled, and late join is available.

All riders comfortable with the advertised pace are welcome.

We ride Monday through Friday at 5:15 PM Eastern Time. Whether you join us occasionally or make it part of your weekday routine, we’d love to see you at the starting line!

Looking for a regular group to ride with? Join CC Riders to stay connected, find upcoming club rides, and get to know your fellow riders. We’re building a friendly group of familiar faces, and there’s always room for another rider.

Join the club:
https://www.zwift.com/clubs/2dce2fec-054a-4b29-a089-28369d430edc/home

Powered by passion. Driven to ride.

name: RO4H Weekend Wander
description:
Welcome to the RO4H Weekend Wander.

The RO4H Weekend Wander is a social group ride hosted by the Ride On 4 Health community, where a friendly, casual, supportive, and respectful atmosphere embraces everyone from the most seasoned Zwifter to the first-time group ride participant.

This ride uses Zwift’s “Keep Everyone Together” (Rubberbanding) feature. Rubberbanding keeps everyone in the group together by adjusting in-game speed so riders of different power levels stay together. Your actual watts are still recorded, but speed and segment times won’t reflect normal in-game physics. Just ride at a comfortable effort and enjoy staying with the group from start to finish.

So come along for the RO4H Weekend Wander — you'll almost certainly break a sweat, undoubtedly hear a few dad jokes, and might even have some fun.

name: ZTBR - Training Stabilization TTT
description:
Zwift Teams Brazil [ZTBR] together with Assessoria Franklin Almeida, provides this training with a focus on providing better "Stabilization" in the performance of athletes seeking better performance in Team Time Trial (TTT) events.

This training aims to help the athlete tolerate and withstand an accumulation of substrates produced by the body in sub-maximal activities, bringing more stability and control in time-based tests.

Franklin Almeida Consulting was created in 2005, with the aim of evaluating the physiological profile, developing training to improve your physical capacity, health and maximum performance.
One of the pioneers in distance consulting in Brazil!

Note: We will have other phases of this training in addition to Stabilization, they are: (Training for FTP Gains and Terrain Variations).

===
Português:
Treino de Estabilização by Franklin Almeida

Descrição: O Zwift Teams Brazil [ZTBR] juntamente com a Assessoria Franklin Almeida, disponibiliza este treino com foco em proporcionar melhor "Estabilização" na performance de atletas que buscam um melhor desempenho nos eventos tipo Team Time Trial (TTT).

Esse treino tem o objetivo de ajudar o atleta a tolerar e suportar um acúmulo de sustratos produzidos pelo organismo em atividades sub máximas trazendo mais estabilidade e controle em provas de conta relógio.

A Consultoria Franklin Almeida foi criada em 2005, com o objetivo de avaliar o perfil fisiológico, desenvolver treinos para melhorar sua capacidade física, sua saúde e desempenho máximo.
Um dos pioneiros em consultoria a distância no Brasil!

Obs.: Teremos outras fases deste treinamento além da Estabilização, são elas: (Treino para Ganhos de FTP e Variações de terreno).

name: Torturefest | ITT Climbing League | Surrey Hills | Week 3
description:
ITT Climbing League where elevation is the target not distance. The clock runs from Pen to virtual banner finish. The routes have been designed to provide lots of world and climb variations to keep it interesting and challenging.

Week 1 Max Elevation 250 meters
Week 2 Max Elevation 450 meters
Week 3 Max Elevation 650 meters
Week 4 Max Elevation 850 meters
Week 5 when it rarely happens….Alpe Du Zwift

These races are not like the other KOM segment smash races, racing strategy comes to play. You will have to work different power ranges, manage energy levels and ponder bike choices. 
•	No draft regardless of bike.
•	No Power up’s just you and your watts.
•	Weekly distances will fluctuate, for example week 2 could be 15km and week 3 only 10km, elevation is primary focus.
•	Category enforced, must wear HRM.
•	ZwiftPower league in place for weekly and monthly results. Identical setup to zwift power.
•	Some weeks will have long lead-ins to the climb which creates the bike choice dilemma; TT bike, climbing bike or mid race bike change?
•	What is the intensity of your effort on each climb in a week where the course has multiple climbs?
•	How do you regulate your power on the flat sections before or between climbs?  

One week its long drag climbs, next week its multiple smaller climbs…weekly climbing Russian roulette style.

description:

This training aims to help the athlete tolerate and withstand an accumulation of substrates produced by the body in sub-maximal activities, bringing more stability and control in time-based tests.

Franklin Almeida Consulting was created in 2005, with the aim of evaluating the physiological profile, developing training to improve your physical capacity, health and maximum performance.
One of the pioneers in distance consulting in Brazil!

Note: We will have other phases of this training in addition to Stabilization, they are: (Training for FTP Gains and Terrain Variations).

Treino de Estabilização by Franklin Almeida

Esse treino tem o objetivo de ajudar o atleta a tolerar e suportar um acúmulo de sustratos produzidos pelo organismo em atividades sub máximas trazendo mais estabilidade e controle em provas de conta relógio.

name: Mountain Massif structured training:  V02 Max
description:
Created by Matteo Cigala, from Cigala Cycling, this structured training session is designed to help you cycle at a higher intensity.  For coaching and all your training needs visit https://coaching.cigalacycling.com/trainsmarterridefaster

About the session:
 This session targets aerobic readiness, controlled sub-threshold work, and high-quality VO2Max development. The warm up prepares the athlete for early intensity changes. The opening tempo and threshold sets elevate heart rate and prime muscular engagement without creating excessive fatigue. The VO2Max blocks form the core of the session, using repeated 1-minute high-intensity efforts to build aerobic power, oxygen uptake efficiency, and the ability to recover quickly between intervals. Recovery periods ensure the athlete maintains quality throughout the session. The cool down supports gradual heart-rate reduction and metabolic clearance.
Session details:
Warm Up 
5 min 40–65% CP 100–110 rpm

2 x Sets 
3 min at 80% CP, free cadence 
1 min at 95% CP, free cadence 
1 min recovery at 50–60% CP, 100–110 rpm

Recovery 
10 min 50–60% CP 100–110 rpm
2 x VO2Max Sets (10 minutes each) Structure: 1 min ON at 120% CP, free cadence 1 min OFF at 55% CP, free cadence Repeat for 10 minutes per set
5 min recovery between sets 50–60% CP 100–110 rpm

Cool Down 
5 min 40–55% CP 100–110 rpm

Total Time: 60 minutes

Key coaching cues: 
Maintain smooth transitions between intensities. During VO2Max efforts, focus on controlled power rather than sprinting. Keep upper body relaxed and breathing rhythmic. Use recoveries to reset technique and cadence before the next block.

Safety Note: 
Only undertake vigorous exercise if you are fit and healthy to do so. If you are at all unsure, consult a Physician or Doctor first. All training equipment including Bikes and Turbo trainers should be in full working order. Do not use any piece of equipment that does not come up to the required standard.
More information:
For more information check out the Mountain Massif website www.mountainmassif.com, follow on Instagram @mountain_massif, Facebook @mountainmassif and join our Zwift Club, by clicking the following link https://www.zwift.com/clubs/mountainmassif/home
To record all your training data and chart your progress, consider using the TrainingPeaks app or Vekta by following the link https://joinvekta.com/

name: Friday Fearless Fartleks
description:
Fartlek, which means speed play in Swedish, is continuous training with interval training. Fartlek runs are a very simple form of a long distance run. Fartlek training is simply defined as periods of fast running intermixed with periods of slower running. For some people, this could be a mix of jogging and sprinting, but for beginners it could be walking with jogging sections added in when possible.

A good laugh and a long run are the two best cures for anything.

Join to challenge yourself and for the group run fun!

name: Old Dog Racing - Masters Tour
description:
Old Dog Racing presents the Masters Tour. A series of shorter and relatively easier races for intermediate level riders.

All races are categorized by age, because to be completely frank, it’s the best racing you can find on Zwift. If you know, you know. And if you don’t you will! Everyone is welcome to race with us, bring some friends and a nemesis or two.

Come and join the fun; A six week tour, Three start times per week, Wednesdays 5:35 pm Eastern; Thursdays 5:35 pm GMT and Fridays 5:35pm Pacific.
Your best finish position each week will count towards your points total.

Races will be mass start and all riders visible, participants will be issued the Zwift Category kit as an aid to identify which category riders you are currently racing against.

The Categories are divided by age as shown below:
A Under 40 (red) B 40-49 (green) C 50-59 (blue) D 60-69 (yellow) and E 70 and over. (purple)

A word of warning; if you haven’t tried age based (masters) racing before, watch out for the yellow and purple jerseys! Those old guys can be surprisingly fast!

Power ups to help you along your way include: The van, the steamroller, the feather, and aero.

Points awarded to each category in every race are: 25, 20,16,13,11,10,9,8,7,6 and 5 very generous participation points!! (You have to finish!). 

Highest accumulated points in each category wins the tour; you’re going to have to wear an HRM and have a Zwift Power account in order to be awarded points.

Overall Tour winner may be eligible to win an Old Dog Racing Mug! (Details on companion club page.).

Join us on :
Zwift Companion https://www.zwift.com/clubs/0ad7655f-797b-4dc2-940d-b313fca0df0a/home
Facebook - https://www.facebook.com/groups/3001328763388965
or Strava -  https://strava.app.link/7JqgUWGwu1b

WOOF!

name: Torturefest | ITT Climbing League | Surrey Hills | Week 3
description:
ITT Climbing League where elevation is the target not distance. The clock runs from Pen to virtual banner finish. The routes have been designed to provide lots of world and climb variations to keep it interesting and challenging.

Week 1 Max Elevation 250 meters
Week 2 Max Elevation 450 meters
Week 3 Max Elevation 650 meters
Week 4 Max Elevation 850 meters
Week 5 when it rarely happens….Alpe Du Zwift

These races are not like the other KOM segment smash races, racing strategy comes to play. You will have to work different power ranges, manage energy levels and ponder bike choices. 
•	No draft regardless of bike.
•	No Power up’s just you and your watts.
•	Weekly distances will fluctuate, for example week 2 could be 15km and week 3 only 10km, elevation is primary focus.
•	Category enforced, must wear HRM.
•	ZwiftPower league in place for weekly and monthly results. Identical setup to zwift power.
•	Some weeks will have long lead-ins to the climb which creates the bike choice dilemma; TT bike, climbing bike or mid race bike change?
•	What is the intensity of your effort on each climb in a week where the course has multiple climbs?
•	How do you regulate your power on the flat sections before or between climbs?  

One week its long drag climbs, next week its multiple smaller climbs…weekly climbing Russian roulette style.

name: Zwift TT Club Racing - Island Hopper
description:
The Time Trial. Cycling’s true leveler - just you and your legs versus everyone else in the field.

Come join Zwift TT Club on Zwift for more Time Trial event information! https://www.zwift.com/clubs/b3d1a903-df49-44eb-9c6f-4ba9f0622efe/home

name: Friday Night Fun Race
description:
Get ready for the Friday Night Fun Race – the perfect way to unwind and kick-off your weekend! This is fast, friendly, and totally unserious racing designed for pure enjoyment.

Every week brings a different course and theme, so you never know what fun-fueled surprise awaits! And if that wasn't enough, everyone starts with a 'BOOST' power-up, with extras available throughout the race – that’s a speed increase for a few seconds – use it wisely!

SCHEDULE
Races are held weekly on Friday evenings across various timezones.

CATEGORIES
You’ll be categorized by your existing Racing Score for fair competition. But don't worry – race results won't impact your score, keeping the pressure low and the fun high.

Sign up for the ultimate Friday night race – fun-filled, feel-good, and guaranteed to make your weekend start with a bang!

name: Zwift Crit Racing Club - Volcano Circuit CCW
description:
It's Crit time! Come and join in the fun on a number of multi-lap short routes. Get ready to dig deep and push to the finish line!

What is Racing Score?

Racing Score is an intuitive system that replaces the traditional categories (A - D) with a 0-1000 scale to reflect your current level, considering various metrics like race performances and power. This score helps Zwift recommend the most competitive band to race in, ensuring a fun, rewarding, and exciting experience as you track your progression throughout your Zwift racing adventures.

WHAT IS ZWIFT POWER? For further information on connecting to Zwift Power check out this support page: https://support.zwift.com/en_us/connecting-to-zwiftpower-SyldRc_4H

Please note; for your results to show up in Zwift Power you must be using a Heart Rate Monitor (HRM) and be riding on a smart trainer, smart bike, or using a power meter.

name: TeamZF Zinger Social 🚴🏻‍♂️
description:
Come one, come all for our TeamZF Beginner Zinger Social ride! This delightful bunch will keep you entertained for a pleasing average pace of 1.3 – 1.5 w/kg. We’ll stick to the advertised pace and ride for an hour or 1 lap, depending on the course of the day. 

This is a great ride for beginners just learning their way around Zwift and seasoned Zwifters, alike. The beacon’s where it’s at, so stick with your ride leader for the most chatter and support. You can always help your teammates earn extra drops by passing out Ride Ons as you go! 

If you would like to represent TeamZF officially please add “TeamZF” after your name and join our Zwiftpower Team: https://zwiftpower.com/team.php?id=1469

Please make sure you join out Official Club via the Companion App to keep up with upcoming events. Alternatively bookmark the link to all our public events: https://www.zwift.com/events/tag/teamzf

If social media is your thing, Join our fun and supportive community on facebook: 
www.facebook.com/groups/teamzf/

*** Please respect the leader’s instructions and advertised pace. Although we pride ourselves on riding within the advertised pace PLEASE NOTE, wk/g average will differ from each rider and change with the route terrain ***

description:
Congratulations, you crushed another week of workouts! If you’re looking to cap off a great week with another can't-miss training session, check out Fast Friday on Zwift. 

A new workout series to put in your weekly run rotation, Fast Friday is a simple and streamlined way to get your heart rate up. We’re focusing on short reps here, clocking in fast intervals that help runners increase their top speed. Short. Sharp. Fast. High-intensity intervals are proven to take your performance to the next level. So lace up and get moving for just 20–30 minutes every Friday before checking out of the office and into the weekend.

eventSubgroups.name: Cycle Nation Endurance Ride (B)
eventSubgroups.description:
The Cat B ride is structured in three parts:
The first tempo section is a steady, controlled effort at 3.0-3.2 w/kg to settle in.
Then comes the twist - approximately 10 minutes at 4.0-4.5 w/kg.
Then we finish with a final steady block at 3.0-3.2 w/kg for 5 laps, with optional sprints, focussing on control, consistency, and finishing together.

eventSubgroups.name: Cycle Nation Endurance Ride (C)
eventSubgroups.description:
The Cat C ride is structured in three parts:
The first tempo section is a steady, controlled effort at 2.8-3.0 w/kg to settle in.
Then comes the twist - approximately 10 minutes at 3.0-3.5 w/kg.
Then we finish with a final steady block at 2.8-3.0 w/kg for 5 laps, with optional sprints, focussing on control, consistency, and finishing together.

description:
Zapraszamy na wspólny poranny event z ZTPL Cycling Club.
Z założenia nasze jazdy prowadzą liderzy, którzy pomagają trzymać peleton w ryzach. Jeśli podczas eventu zabraknie lidera, starajcie się trzymać tempo na które się umówiliśmy w momencie gdy dołączyliście do wybranej grupy. To od Was zależy jak będziecie się bawić 😊

description:
Vitality, in partnership with UNICEF, is teaming up with Zwift for a series of great social rides for a fantastic cause. Don’t miss out. Join our social rides of 45 minutes to one hour and do your part to give kids a head start. Keeping you active and helping Vitality and UNICEF vaccinate millions of children worldwide.

About Vitality:
 
Guided by a core purpose of making people healthier, Vitality is the leader in shared-value by creating healthy behavior changes in insurance. By blending technology, data, incentives, and behavioural science, Vitality inspires healthy changes in individuals and organizations. 

In partnership with UNICEF, Vitality aims to vaccinate millions of children against polio by donating vaccines on behalf of participants who complete the Vitality for UNICEF Ride series events.

name: RwB Saturday Summit Seekers
description:
The weekend starts with altitude.
Coffee can wait. Legs first.

Join Team RwB every Saturday at 07:00 CET for a Gran Fondo-inspired climbing session featuring repeated hill efforts, controlled pacing, and plenty of opportunities to test your limits and make your breakfast feel nervous.

B riders: this is your home turf. C riders: come and discover just how strong you really are. A riders: enjoy a solid tempo ride and try not to disappear over the horizon.

Expect effort. Expect banter. Expect that moment halfway through a climb when you question your life choices.
Then expect to finish stronger than last week.
Clip in. Climb hard. Earn your Saturday.
The mountains don't care about excuses. Let's go climbing.

Ride Together. Climb Together. RwB Together.

name: Team Italy Saturday Morning Fever
description:
Team Italy Saturday Morning Fever Ride, this is our sporty way to start into the weekend.
Join us for an avg 2.5 to 3.0 W/kg ride, 90 minutes, perfect to improve your endurance. The individual power range depends on course and leader - please check the weekly individual announcement. Independent of your fitness level (pro, ambitious rider, newbie, who wants to go fast) we ride and chat and have fun.
For those, who want to join Italian fast conversations, please join our corresponding discord channel: https://discord.gg/TSYYfgtSJw

Our sweeper team will help you, if requested. Experience with group rides is of advantage - we will use the power of the group to go fast.
Attention: First timers will unlock the Team Italy Jersey with this ride.

name: Granfondo Scannellatori
description:
Saturday is time for Grand Fondo!
Some routes on Zwift are too hard to be ridden alone.
No worries, Scannellatori Seriali helps you with this new series.

The event is set as a race but everybody is free to decide how to ride it, like in a GF.
You can race pushing to your limit or ride it as a group ride, finding a GRUPPETTO with the same tempo and enjoying the DOUBLE DRAFT.

Join us, find your Gruppetto and complete some of the most challenging routes on Zwift!

-double draft
-steering enabled
-one start for everyone

name: NO LIMIT CC – SOCIAL - RUBBER BAND & ROLL
description:
👥 No Limit Cycling Club is a community-led cycling club built around consistency, confidence, and riding together. Riders of all backgrounds and abilities are welcome.

🌤 Rubber Band & Roll is a relaxed weekend group ride using Zwift’s Rubber Band feature to help keep the group together. Ride steady with the pack, sit in the draft, or take short pulls knowing the group will regroup. The focus is smooth group riding and good vibes.

🗺 Routes rotate across Zwift worlds including Watopia, France, and Makuri Islands to keep rides fresh and fun.

🧭 Ride leads manage pacing and communication. Sweepers check in with riders and help regroup when needed.

🔒Warm-up around 1.5 w/kg, then settle into 1.8–2.2 w/kg. Fence is on to keep the group together and may be lifted during sprints and towards the end.

🎽 Ride with NLCC to unlock and wear the official No Limit CC Zwift kit.

🔁 Other NLCC rides
Tue 7:00 PM GMT
Thu 7:00 PM GMT
Sat 7:00 AM GMT

📲 Contact
NLCC on Zwift: https://www.zwift.com/clubs/469e53e5-462c-4aa7-b34c-026384533c0b/home

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/nolimit.bike

name: SZR  Endurance Ride
description:
The goal with the SZR Endurance Ride is to focus on the Group and keeping the Group together while having fun to make the time fly fast!

The SZR Endurance Ride is divided into C, D and E categories, the tempo is shown next to the ride category, this is rider weight / gender dependant.

Please make sure you choose the correct group when signing up for this ride.

Note that the average is for the total ride! There might be variations above or under the average during the ride.

- This is a social group ride and not a race. Staying close to the ride leader is the key. Respect and support the group!
- Follow the ride leaders instructions at all times.
- After steep hills we focus on getting the group together. Soft pedal if ahead to regroup faster.
- In case of a drop-out or any other issues, we do have great sweep support to help you back to the group!

Communication is the key so make sure you can call (chat message) out for help and do it as soon as possible.

Use our discord if you like to have a real talk with the people on the ride:
https://discord.gg/DQHybQT
You'll find us in the Endurance Ride C/D/E channels

name: 3R Endurance Steady Ride
description:
This is a 3R Group Ride Event. Your co-operation and teamwork is essential to the success of the ride and we ask that no riders ride off the front of the group. The event is designed as part of 3R’s package of #ProStyleTraining events to assist with the attainment of your training goals and may include intervals over and below the ride average parameters. This is not a race so please follow the leader beacon's (Yellow) instructions and if you are feeling strong, please help the keeper beacon (Red) to assist other riders back to the pack. We welcome good banter and aim to create a fun, social atmosphere for your training. We welcome any feedback on our Facebook page https://www.facebook.com/groups/ClubWorldBicycleRelief/ #Team3R #Ride3R #RideRaceRaise.
#3r

The A category ride is for riders looking for a ride comparable to a ride in real life, going easy on flats and hard on the climbs.

Mostly not fenced to have the opportunities for PRs.

A minimum FTP of 4.0w/kg is recommended.

name: EVO CC Endurance Ride [2.5-2.7w/kg avg]
description:
Welcome to the Evolution Cycling Club [EVO] weekend edition. This ride is geared towards Zwifters that are looking for a longer steady cat C ride.
The average for the ride being around the 2.5-2.7w/kg depending on the riders weight and course.

Strong riders are always welcome to help and offer assistance at the back. We welcome good chat and a social atmosphere for new and experienced Zwifters alike, everyone is welcome.
Total ride time circa 4Hrs 15 / 4Hrs 20 - course depending.
#evo #doubledraft

eventSubgroups.name: EVO CC Endurance Ride [2.5-2.7w/kg avg] (C)
eventSubgroups.description:
Welcome to the Evolution Cycling Club [EVO] weekend edition. These rides are geared towards Zwifter’s that are looking for a longer ride Cat B & Cat C ride.

The average for the Cat B group will be 3.0-3.2 w/kg, depending on riders weight, course and leader, with the Cat C group being around the 2.5-2.7w/kg.

Strong riders are always welcomed to assist the group and help riders back into the pack.

High social interaction is a feature of EVO rides, so bring your best banter! Use the mobile app or a keyboard to communicate in-ride.

#evo #doubledraft

name: Bikealicious Joy Ride
description:
This is a social ride welcoming all riders. Our mission is to push you further than before, build your endurance, and have fun. If you are feeling strong, push to the front and drag the group; if not, just sit in the peloton.

We have the “rubber-band” activated, which means it’s a no-drop ride. No matter what level you are, you’ll be able to keep up, and the group will stay together. Please note that the overall speed may be lower than in other rides due to the banding effect.

So hop on that bike, grab those bottles, and let’s ride!

name: zFondo Series
description:
Welcome to the zFondo Series! A fondo is a giant group ride and a go-at-your-own-pace event. This year’s zFondo series explores a variety of our longer routes - with a moderate amount of climbing mixed in, bringing together Zwifters looking to take on an epic challenge and push themselves toward new endurance goals. 

Each month you’ll have the opportunity to unlock a legacy Zwift Fondo kit. 
*December Festive Fondo will have a unique unlock - stay tuned!

RIDE SCHEDULE

ZFondo weekends will take place the last weekend of each month, starting September 25, 2026 and ending on March 28, 2027: 

October 23, 2026 - October 25, 2026
Route: Makuri Pretzel

name: Vikings Valhalla Saturday Shenanigans
description:
Fancy a lie in? Need a ride a little later than the Early Bird Shenanigans? No need to look any further. Welcome to Valhalla Saturday Shenanigans - the perfect ride for all those who are looking for a fun and cheeky ride as soon as the sun rises and the birds are already singing.

Valhalla are all about teamwork and that‘s why all we ask from you is to work as a group and bring some fun blather.

We offer you a cheerful ride with different leaders and courses every week with two different groups of effort levels. Expect an avg ride pace between 1.8 wkg and 2.7 wkg depending on lead, course and group. The pace may vary on certain parts of the course or for a certain time.

Please come and join us on our Valhalla Shenanigans Ride and enjoy the Valhalla way of working together and for one goal.

Find out more about Team Valhalla and the Vikings on our Facebook page and sign up for your next group ride today:
https://www.facebook.com/groups/503388660165279

#vikingsvalhalla

This endurance event on a week by week basis will either be for 75 mins, 75kms or course specific.

		          D 1.8 > 2.2wkg but expect the event to finish around 2.0wkg based on a 75kg rider

name: TNP Chain Gang
description:
50km group ride on the Canyon Speedmax CFR.									
This is not a race. This is a chain gang.									
Ride together as a group and work to maintain a steady pace. Take turns on the front, keep the group rolling, and hold the wheel as long as you can.									
Use the Cadex Tri (draft enabled) while collecting kms towards upgrading your bikes.									
Go to the front. Take your turn. No passengers.

name: Torturefest | ITT Climbing League | Surrey Hills | Week 3
description:
ITT Climbing League where elevation is the target not distance. The clock runs from Pen to virtual banner finish. The routes have been designed to provide lots of world and climb variations to keep it interesting and challenging.

Week 1 Max Elevation 250 meters
Week 2 Max Elevation 450 meters
Week 3 Max Elevation 650 meters
Week 4 Max Elevation 850 meters
Week 5 when it rarely happens….Alpe Du Zwift

These races are not like the other KOM segment smash races, racing strategy comes to play. You will have to work different power ranges, manage energy levels and ponder bike choices. 
•	No draft regardless of bike.
•	No Power up’s just you and your watts.
•	Weekly distances will fluctuate, for example week 2 could be 15km and week 3 only 10km, elevation is primary focus.
•	Category enforced, must wear HRM.
•	ZwiftPower league in place for weekly and monthly results. Identical setup to zwift power.
•	Some weeks will have long lead-ins to the climb which creates the bike choice dilemma; TT bike, climbing bike or mid race bike change?
•	What is the intensity of your effort on each climb in a week where the course has multiple climbs?
•	How do you regulate your power on the flat sections before or between climbs?  

One week its long drag climbs, next week its multiple smaller climbs…weekly climbing Russian roulette style.

name: EVO CC Fusion Endurance Ride! [2.2-2.4w/kg avg]
description:
Welcome to the Evolution Cycling Club [EVO] Fusion Endurance Ride. The ride is geared towards Zwifter’s that are looking for a steady paced ride within a friendly group ride setting, like a coffee ride. The average for the ride will be between 2.2-2.4w/kg depending on riders weight, course and leader. The ride course may vary and at times may include more hillier rides therefore the watts per kilo may be above/below the advertised figures as they are only an average.

The group is based upon high social interaction so bring your best banter. Please use the companion app or a keyboard to communicate in-ride.

name: Velos Sofa to Saddle ride.
description:
Welcome to Team Velos, this is a gentle ride aimed at newcomers or novice cyclists who are starting out on their Zwift journey. We will start off at .8 w/kg and we will very gradually raise the pace to 1.3 w/kg maximum over the 45 minutes. Our Team will answer any questions you have regarding your Zwift set up and guide you through the wonderful worlds of Zwift. The ride will hopefully give you the encouragement to leave that comfy sofa and build your strength to join our faster rides in the future, our team will encourage you and help with every pedal stroke to reach your goal.

It’s not a race and there is nothing to win here just the satisfaction of getting off the sofa early on a Saturday morning and then you can get on with your weekend.

Join our Zwift club at teamvelos.co.uk

name: DBM Group Workout
description:
Den Blå Mur (DBM) rides Group Workout interval sessions on Saturdays at 09.00 am CET. 

We use standard workouts from the Zwift coaches - and mainly with focus on threshold development. The power zones get adjusted for each rider based on the individual power zones. We have ""stay together"" mode activated,  so we stay in one group regardless of the different power outputs. 

This gives great motivation and energy - and the intervals go by so much ""faster""! Come, join us!, 
------
DBM is a Danish based society for female cyclists on Zwift. Our main purpose is to encourage as many women as we possibly can to join us - and get stronger together, whilst having a good time.

We include everybody, and we see it as our most important goal, to give everybody a good experience.

DBM stands for ""Den Blå Mur"", in Danish it refers to a blue wall, as our society has been a big player in the Danish Zwift leagues, and therefore formed a ""blue walll"" at the races, in our Camo jerseys.

name: Watts More Rendurance!
description:
Watts More! Ride with friends in challenging events. Take on your challenge in Watts, elevation or duration!

 

Saturday morning, an endurance ride is the ideal way to start your weekend. We ride together in a steady ride at about 2.4 w/kg AVG on mostly flat tracks.
Ride leaders vary and will cheer you on during this ride that will take exact two hours. All riders are encouraged to keep the bunch together, so we can start and finish as one happy blob.
Everybody is welcome as long as you make a positive contribution in making this a good and relaxed start of the weekend.

 

From October until March these rides are guided with a rideleader. From April until September most rides are without rideleader. In that case don’t argue, blob up and be nice.

 

Check out our weekly ride announcements on the Watts More Facebook https://www.facebook.com/groups/1151203888657006/?ref=share

name: PAOLO BARBERA & SCANNELLATORI SERIALI WORKOUT
description:
"Scannellatori Seriali" is a large community of cyclists, triathletes, and runners. We invite you to join our community by following our Instagram page at https://www.instagram.com/scannellatori_seriali/ or contacting us on Facebook.
 
Coach Paolo Barbera (Please visit www.heycoach.it )   is a Certified Triathlon and Ironman Coach and the founder of Active Kids, a sporting clinic to help children and adults in the prevention and treatment of obesity through healty nutrition and tailored training programs

Paolo is an experienced thriathlete and cyclist, in 2017 opened an endurance training center in milan, Tri60, specilized in indoor training.

In the last ten years Paolo has developed training programs for triathletes, runners and cyclists. Indoor training plays a key role to control pace, cadence and mental strenght.

Paolo’s workouts are designed to mix different training zones aiming to maximize results in a very short time. Paolo’s coachees by following his workouts, at the right intensity, have achieved challenging results.

Ride leaders vary and will cheer you on during this ride that will take exact two hours. All riders are encouraged to keep the bunch together, so we can start and finish as one happy blob.
Everybody is welcome as long as you make a positive contribution in making this a good and relaxed start of the weekend. Please have a nice chat and ride, and do share your beers/drinks after the ride on our HIK Facebook Group page.

These rides will be guided between 1st Sunday of October until the last Sunday of March. From 1st Sunday of April until last Sunday of September they are scheduled a free ride (no lead).
Check out our weekly ride announcements on the HIK Facebook https://www.facebook.com/groups/hetiskoers

name: Team CLS Base 'n' Banter
description:
Base ’n’ Banter is a controlled weekend endurance ride - with a strong community and social focus! 

Across every weekend in 2026, we will continue to offer a mix of rides that cover flat, rolling and hilly terrain with the aim of getting in a solid endurance ride, mostly around 2hrs.

This is a chance to enjoy a friendly experienced group club ride with regulars who have no Big Egos. While you build your fitness, there is always plenty of in-ride banter. 

What pace to expect?
We will ride the flats around 2.5 - 2.7 w/kg with a focus on keeping everyone together!

The leader will climb at around 3.0 - 3.2 w/kg depending on the length and if needed we will always try and regroup after.

While the leader will do everything to keep everyone together, we can't slow repeatedly so some splits are inevitable.

Our SWEEPERS on this ride, known as our ‘ORANGE ARMY’ (OA), are members of TEAM CLS who are dedicated to helping others. If you have had a drop out or accidentally hit a wrong key, type ‘HELP’ and they will come back and offer you a wheel back to the group.

Note: While we always try to ensure this ride is led by one of our beacons there may be some weeks where this is not possible. The ride always has regulars that will ride to the advertised pace!

name: THE FAST LANE
description:
Welcome to The Fast Lane presented by ZDR in collaboration with WBR500. Three hours of steady endurance, fast TT bikes and working together to take your riding to the next level.

This is a true long-distance endurance ride designed to keep a steady power pace, build aerobic fitness and rack up your miles and XP.  We’re here to keep the pressure on the pedals, make the most of our time on the bike and enjoy some friendly chat while we grind.

All riders are welcome. No discrimination, no egos - just good people putting in the work together.

The goal is consistent endurance riding, not attacking, chasing, or turning every incline into a competition. We ride together, keep the pace steady and help maintain group cohesion throughout the three hours.

A few things to keep in mind:

While all riders will be assigned a fast TT bike with the fastest wheelset in draft mode, you will still be upgrading your bike of choice selected in your garage before starting the ride.

Steady power, steady progress. The aim is to stay within a consistent endurance power range. Save the big efforts for another day.

Ride as a group. Listen to the ride leader, follow their pacing guidance and help keep the group together.

Three hours means three hours. Settle in, fuel properly and embrace the long game. This is about sustainable effort, not short bursts of glory.

Late join is welcome. Join within the first 30 minutes if you can and settle into the group as smoothly as possible.

Sweeps when needed. Nobody should feel abandoned. If you’re struggling to hold the group, speak up early so we can work out the best way to help.

Be smart on climbs. Follow the leader’s instructions and keep the effort controlled. If you want to push harder, take a pull on the flats rather than disrupting the group on every climb.

Respect the pace. This is endurance training, not a hard-climb-and-coast ride. Consistency is the point.

And above all, be a decent human being.

We train together, support each other and make the long hours count. Whether you’re here for the endurance, the XP, the upgrades or simply the company, you’re part of the group.

Three hours. Steady pressure. No shortcuts. Ride the fast lane.

name: Bikes – Gravel & Dust
description:
Envie de s'envoyer une bonne dose de poussière virtuelle et de transpirer ensemble ? Ce samedi, le club "Bikes" vous donne rendez-vous pour une sortie gravel exclusive sur Zwift.
Pour garder un esprit d'équipe et des conditions équitables pour tout le monde, le vélo est imposé : votre fidèle destrier est un gravel Spezialed Crux (cadre et roues typés gravel).
Au programme : de la relance, des portions vallonnées, de la poussière, de la bonne humeur et, bien sûr, l'indispensable papotage sur Discord pour ceux qui ont du souffle.

Notre Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/groups/ZwiftBikes
Rejoins-nous : https://www.bikesfrance.com/
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Want to get a good dose of virtual dust and break a sweat together? This Saturday, the “Bikes” club invites you to join them for an exclusive gravel ride on Zwift.
To keep the team spirit alive and ensure a level playing field for everyone, the bike is mandatory: your trusty steed is a Spezialed Crux gravel bike (with a gravel-style frame and wheels).

Get your water bottles ready, adjust your cleats, and come join the “Bikes” peloton. Who’s in?

name: ZZRC Bring a Bidon Social Ride
description:
Welcome to our ZZRC Bring a Bidon 2.4-2.7. This is a group ride, not a race, where we encourage riding together.

Our rides are open to all riders, the category enforcement merely allows us to ensure a safe and quality ride for you the riders and for our group.

In 2015 ZZRC was founded and are one of the oldest established clubs on Zwift .

YELLOW BEACON will pace between 2.4-2.7 on the ride , with a possible increase of watts on inclines or sprints , but the average for the whole ride will be as advertised

We strongly promote group riding so on most of our rides we will use the Fence to help encourage that. Using a fence ensures that the ride is not over paced .

In the event of falling off the back of the main group , you will need to pace well over group pace to bridge the gap and catch .

This is where our awesome ZZRC sweeps and Ride Buddies will help you return to group using their draft. They will give you clear encouraging instructions to aid this process .

Our crew are a caring bunch who dedicate a lot of hours to this club , but want you to have the best ride experience on Zwift

You will be fully supported and encouraged throughout the ride by the Leader, Sweeps and Ride Buddies .

Our rides do not allow the use of TT Bikes as they do not draft and will require you to push harder on the ride, and in these instances our Sweeps will not be able to help you .

Mountain bikes operate very similarly, minimum draft so more watts (effort) will be required for the ride and any chase backs to group .

All our rides have a 30 minute late join feature which allows you to rejoin if you have technical issues or you find yourself out of the group in the early stages of the ride. Using this feature SHOULD teleport you back into the main group with our YELLOW BEACON .


We love to have a chat on our rides so join us
on Discord: https://discord.gg/QdeS3PtXTX


TOP TIPS

1) Stay close to the ride leader (or just in front on climbs), don’t let a gap form and the elastic snap!

2) Stay away from the Fence – We don’t like to fry anyone

3) Most important of all . . . HAVE FUN AND ENJOY THE RIDE.

#zzrc

Don’t forget to join our ZZRC-We Pace Not Race Facebook page and our club on the companion app

name: DBR Saturday Race
description:
Welcome to DBR Saturday Race.

All RS categories will start at the same time. Expect each race to be highly competitive and have fun.

Categories
Each race will be using Zwift Racing Score (ZRS) for categorization.
race up a category, if your RS is at the top end of a category. Or if you simply desire an added challenge.

- A: 1000 =< 690
- B:690<520
- C:520<350
- D:350<180
- E:180<=0

Your Zwift Racing Score is determined by how much success you have in races.
better against people with higher ZRS, then your ZRS may increase. If you place worse than people with lower ZRS, then your score might decrease. Read more about ZRS here - https://support.zwift.com/en_us/racing-score-faq-BkG9_Rqrh <https://support.zwift.com/en_us/racing-score-faq-BkG9_Rqrh>

If your ZRS increases past a category boundary during the series, your points earned will not transfer to the new category with you.

RULES:
Smart trainer or power meter is required. zPower will be removed.
Heart rate monitors are compulsory for all categories.
No TT bikes unless it's a TT event.
You need to have a registered account with Zwiftpower.com and accept their terms and conditions to be in the results of the race.

Misc.
Race organizers may request riders in all categories to provide a dual recording or a matching RL effort (Strava) in order to verify a Zwift race effort. Failure to comply may result in disqualification from the event. Failure to provide a dual recording or RL effort on three requests may result in disqualification from future events, until a dual recording with a matching effort is provided.
Race organizers may exclude a rider from the results, due to poor sportsmanship. Examples may be bad language, sandbagging or other behavior of a disruptive manner.

The Leader will text instructions as well as use discord voice chat as communication is the key to a good group ride. Sweepers will also be in operation to assist in helping the group stay together as this is a non-drop ride.

All riders will appear in the same kit and you can optionally add (PACK) after your name to show support of the group. Please respect the pace set by the leader, this is a group ride not a race. #strongertogether

name: Tiny Race (1 of 4) by Zwift Insider
description:
IMPORTANT: read these notes to perform your best and avoid disqualification!

Tiny Races are mean to be raced as set of 4 back-to-back events that finish within one hour. Each race is on a different route that takes ~7-12 minutes to complete, and races are scheduled 15 minutes apart.

3 RULES:
- No skipping then returning. You will receive a DQ if you skip race 1, 2, or 3 but finish a later race in the set.
- You must have an active ZwiftPower account to compete for the overall podium.
- Smart trainer or power meter is required.

THIS WEEK'S ROUTES:
Race 1: Sand and Sequoias (6.17km, blind finish exiting twisty tunnel after oasis) - Powerup: Draft Boost
Race 2: Beach Island Loop (6.166km, ends at JWB Sprint) - Powerup: Steamroller
Race 3: Coastal Crown Loop (7km, flatter, ends on Mayan Mountainside) - Powerup:  Aero
Race 4: Jarvis Seaside Sprint (7.585km, ends at Jarvis KOM arch) - Powerup: Feather

PRO TIPS: 
You will receive a single powerup at the start of each race, as listed above. Be sure to visit https://zwiftinsider.com/tiny/ for details on this week's routes, including custom finish line locations.

RESULTS:
You earn points in each race based on your finishing position. The overall category winners each week (available on ZwiftPower) are the riders with the most points across all 4 races. ZwiftPower result links:
- Zone 1 (9am UTC): https://zwiftpower.com/league.php?id=1172

name: HerD Beginner Races
description:
Where do you go to try racing or to grow a little better with your racing craft… Herd Beginner Races is set up to provide you with that opportunity by using Zwift Racing Scores (ZRS) with bandwidths that are set up so you’re competing with people of similarities and routes that enable you to challenge yourself and grow with racing. Our pens are set up so you're racing with others of similar abilities. Zwift will recommend your pen in blue; you can race in a higher up pen but it's not recommended.

Each week HBR races will have a different focus; racing on a flat route, rolling/undulating with a small climbs, and a route that is commonly used in many Zwift racing events. In addition, the last race of the month will be Tick-Tock so that you can monitor your performance.

Join the ZZRC Club on the Companion App, follow us on Facebook, but, most of all, enjoy the ride.

name: Newbury Velo Weekend TT
description:
NEWBURY VELO CLUB TIME TRIALS

Newbury Velo presents your weekly 10 mile TT (and a bit...). No marshals, no sign-on. No fee.

Club results will be posted on our Facebook Page: https://www.facebook.com/newburyvelo 

Riders must be registered on https://www.zwiftpower.com and have their Zwift profile agreed to share with zwiftpower otherwise they will not be included in the results.  Think of it as the signing in process :) details of how to do this can be found here: https://boltrace.team/zwift-power-guide

THE TT HUD

Time Trials offer a unique HUD (Heads Up Display) that emphasizes that this is a race against the clock! You'll also see intermediate timing checkpoints. In Bologna, there are eight of these - one every 1km; in Watopia on the Tempus Fugit course, there are four - each one breaking up the course at a distinct landmark. A center clock timing you to 100ths of a second will keep you on task and you can use the minimap to track your progress.

CORE RULES

* Rather than having an Event start time, each rider will receive their own individual start time when signing up in Zwift Companion; you can still sign up on the web or in-game, but you won't be shown your explicit start time until you enter the paddocks.
* Drafting is disabled for all Zwift Time Trials.
* Time Trial bikes are not required. You can use any bike in your Garage.
* Results for time trials are pending until all riders have finished. You'll see other riders populate the results screen as they finish and your placing will be updated accordingly.

#newburyvelo

name: Madhare Saturday Hill Training
description:
Join our Madhare sessions every Tuesday and Saturday as part of our weekly Autumn/Winter training for new and experienced Zwifters.
Saturday's
Each Week you take on the MUIR AND THE MOUNTAIN...Start off settling into a rhythm for the first few weeks. Getting up and over the summit is the key. Then, start improving your time week-on-week. Start adding in some attacks whilst climbing. Before the spring you'll be attacking the climb all the way up and smashing your PB!
Our beacon is there to set a pace and to talk all things cycling so jump on and join in!
It's not a race, however, if you want to zip off ahead or drop back and relax you can do that too!
*Cat C - 1 - 5w/kg - All Cats'
Join the Mad Hare official Zwift club! Email or follow one of our leaders for an invite.

description:
Welcome to the Saturday Social with BYT ride! The ride will be paced at 1.8-2 throughout the course of the entire ride.

Bikely Youth Team(BYT), is the largest youth team on Zwift. You can join us on Zwift Power if you are under the age of 19, or just join our rides whenever you want if you are not.

Today’s event is a ride paced at 1.8 - 2 W/KG, please stay with the yellow beacon since this is NOT A RACE, and ignore any flyers, and most importantly of all, enjoy the ride!

name: TeamPTz - Joaquim Agostinho Ride
description:
Joaquim Agostinho, 1943~1984, ciclista de elite Português. Entre muitas homenagens, sabias que sempre que sobes o ADZ, 14.ª curva do Alpe d'Huez, podes ver o Busto de J.A., em homenagem à sua vitoria desta mítica etapa no Tour em 1979, (na classificação geral terminou em 3º).

Temos todo o gosto em te convidar para te juntares a nós neste passeio de convívio, em homenagem ao J.A.. Deverás pedalar junto do leader e poderás juntar-te a nós no Discord: https://discord.gg/MtBCtBmch8

Joaquim Agostinho, 1943~1984, Top Portuguese cyclist. Among many honors, did you know that whenever you climd ADZ, turn 14º Alpe d’Huez, you can see J.A. statue, in honour to his victory at 1979 on this mitic stage on tour, (finished overall at 3º).

We are glad to invite you to join us in a social ride, that also honours J.A. You should run together with Leader and you can join us on our Discord server: https://discord.gg/MtBCtBmch8

name: DIRT 505 Saturday Endurance Ride
description:
Welcome to the DIRT 505 Saturday Endurance Special Edition Ride!

Please join us weekly on Saturdays at a pace of 2.6-2.8w/kg for 120 minutes.

The 505 rides take place Monday, Wednesday, Thursday and Friday for 90 minutes at the same time and same consistent pace. Saturday's we ride for 120 minutes.

We kick off our rides with a 5 minute pace at 2.2w/kg to get us warmed up and together as a team. The fence is used throughout the ride to keep everyone together. The fence will not kick you off the ride but we do encourage all our riders to stay together as close to the beacon as possible. Our rides offer a 30 minute late join option.
The ride leader will stay as close to ride pace as possible. We try to change up the routes each week and some of the routes may include some small to moderate climbs.

Our group exists to encourage and build up cyclists around the world no matter your time zone, fitness level, pro or amateur. We exist to encourage and build up a team culture of unity in the cycling community.

https://www.strava.com/clubs/zwiftdirt

https://www.facebook.com/groups/zwiftdirt

Saturday is a special 2 hour edition, same time/pace/vibe.

Our rides offer sweepers to help pull you back to the blob if you need assistance. Please speak up during the ride if you are in need of a sweep. No speaky, no sweepy.

3 back-to-back races, Little Tour Ghost Team style… but the express version.

name: EVO CC Race Series
description:
CATEGORY ENFORCEMENT IS ENABLED FOR ALL EVO RACES!

What is Category Enforcement? 

Category Enforcement will prevent Zwifters from entering a category they are not eligible for.  Our goal is to increase fairness in racing.

HOW DOES IT WORK?

- Zwift checks a racer's past performance using VO2 max and FTP to determine their race category.
- Racers can join a category at or above their category. For example, if you are "C" category, you can race in C, B, or A category. You will not be able to race in the D category and the option to join will be absent.

Welcome to EVO sprintrace series. Start fast, hang on in the middle, then sprint for the win at the finish. Expect to push your heart rate to its maximum. Sprinkle a few of these into your training plan and watch your fitness grow.

To make racing as fair as possible we have enforced a few minor rules that will result in automatic disqualification on ZwiftPower.

All riders must wear a heart rate monitor
Riding in an incorrect category.

zPower riders will be disqualified in A, B, and C Podium. zPower is allowed in the D category. Race details and final results will be available at www.zwiftpower.com

name: Xert Saturday Social – Challenge Yourself!
description:
XERT SATURDAY SOCIAL | CHALLENGE YOURSELF! 

Two pace groups. One supportive community. Challenge yourself with a safety net!
Join the Xert crew every Saturday for a 90-minute social endurance ride designed to help you build fitness throughout the winter. 
 
HOW IT WORKS
We start together with a relaxed 10-minute warmup before splitting into two pace groups:
🔵D GROUP | 2.0–2.4 W/kg
A steady endurance pace, with our leader targeting approximately 2.2 W/kg. Great for riders looking for a consistent, social ride.
🟢C GROUP | 2.6–3.0 W/kg
A faster endurance pace, with our leader targeting approximately 2.7 W/kg. Perfect for riders looking for an extra challenge!
 
CHALLENGE YOURSELF!
Normally ride with D? Try hanging on with C!  After the warmup, the C group will gradually pull ahead. Stay with them as long as you can! If you get dropped, simply ease off and let the D group catch you, then finish the ride at a more comfortable pace.
It’s a great way to challenge yourself, build fitness, and enjoy a harder effort without worrying about finishing alone.
 
SUPPORTIVE GROUP RIDING
Our D group has dedicated volunteer sweepers who will do their best to help riders who fall behind reconnect with the group. Both pace groups have dedicated leaders, so you can choose the pace that works best for you.
 
ROUTE BADGE HUNTING
We’ll rotate routes regularly to keep things interesting. We’re also planning occasional longer rides to tackle some of Zwift’s longer routes and help riders collect route badges!
 
ALL RIDERS WELCOME!
You don’t need to use Xert to participate. Whether you’re looking for a steady endurance ride or want to push yourself with a faster group, we’d love to have you join us. 
 
See you Saturday!

name: DWGZ — Hot Hundo
description:
DWGZ — Hot Hundo

Welcome to DWGZ (Determined Witty Gritty Zwifters) — a global crew of cyclists who show up with grit, humor, heart, and the kind of energy that lifts the whole group. Many of us have zwifted together for years, and some have taken those virtual connections IRL, organizing meetups around the world. DWGZ builds more than fitness — we build community, emotional endurance, and the kind of camaraderie that makes even the hardest efforts feel lighter through shared suffering.

Hot Hundo is exactly what it sounds like: 100 miles, one long day in the saddle, and the second of our two weekly unlock rides — the endurance counterpart to Sunday's climbing test, Fatica Domenicale. Finish the full distance and earn your DWGZ jersey the honest way: steady pacing, deep patience, and good company from start to finish.

Whether you're chasing your first century, building serious base miles, or just want people to talk you through the back half, this one's for you.
Ride Categories 🚴 B Category – 3.2–4.0 w/kg 🚴 C Category – 2.8–3.2 w/kg 🚴 D Category – 2.0–2.6 w/kg

Expect steady pacing, deep camaraderie, and a welcoming group from yellow beacon to sweep, start to finish. Every pocket of the ride is built on teamwork, connection, and that signature DWGZ vibe.

DWGZ rides run seven days a week at 6:05 AM Eastern (US) — each one an opportunity to build strength, connection, and global community.
Clip in, fuel up, and ride the full Hundo with us.

name: HangOn Ride by Team EN
description:
Join Endurance Nation for the Hang-On Ride -- a group ride that will truly test your limits! Warm up at 2.5 W/kg for 10’, then increase to 3.5 over 10’, then 3.5+ as you are able in your group. Your mission -- to HANG ON to the faster riders! Done right, C and D riders can work to stay in the groupetto as the Bs and As push the front and try to catch any fliers right at the end. This is not a race full of surges, but there is plenty of hard work to stay in the group. Casualties are inevitable, but come back and HANG ON longer next week! We will ride for about 60k, so come prepared with lots of fluids and food. Please pay close attention to leader's instructions via message.

Join TeamEN members to chat on an app called Discord. Discord is not required, but the ride experience is enhanced by using it. Click on this link for more information about Discord and related setup: https://www.endurancenation.us/teamen-on-zwift#discord

For more specifics about this ride and various other Endurance Nation rides, go to: https://www.endurancenation.us/teamen-on-zwift

name: RollCo: Rolling Tide - 38K
description:
🌊 ROLLING TIDE
Start small. Build big.
Welcome to Rolling Tide — RollCo’s season-long ritual race.

Every week, the distance grows by 1 km.
It begins as a short, explosive opener and steadily evolves into a full-distance endurance epic by year’s end.
This isn’t a one-off event — it’s a shared journey that rises with you.

🏁 Race Format
Rolling Tide is a categorised scratch race.
All riders start together, with categories keeping the racing fair and fast.
The only thing that changes… is the distance.

Week 1 → 1 km
Week 52 → 52 km

Early weeks reward raw power.
Later weeks demand patience, grit, and endurance.
The tide never stops rising.

Rolling Tide is about more than today’s finish line.
It’s about showing up — week after week.
Seeing the same names.
Measuring how far you’ve come as the distance stretches.

You’ll build rivalries.
You’ll track your progress.
You’ll remember the day it all began.

And by the end of the season, everyone who stayed will share the same truth:

“We rode the whole tide together.”

Why Join Rolling Collective?
We’re more than a club — we’re a global community of riders who support each other, grow together, and celebrate every ride, whether it’s a grind, a badge hunt, or a race. Join us on Discord, connect with fellow riders, and be part of something bigger.

Forward, Together

name: GGCC Glasgow Green Saturday Training Ride
description:
The Glasgow Green Cycle Club GGCC group rides are training and/or social events, category C or D, with a Yellow beacon leader and Red beacon sweeper.

Please look out for our training rides on several days every week. Use #GGCC to search, as in https://zwift.com/events/tag/ggcc, or on Companion.

You should ride as a group, following the instructions of the beacon ride leader(s) for any sprints, intervals and spicy segments, regrouping after each when requested. Our lap or distance-limited group rides also have a closing minirace, to start from behind the Yellow beacon. Our 1-hour rides don’t close with a minirace.

GGCC is a Glasgow-based cycling club whose “in real life” (irl) club runs and training rides are always organised into pace groups, which match the Zwift categories quite well. 

As we expect our club’s riders to be able to ride 50 miles at a 15mph average on our Sunday rides, such steady riding members will be comfortable with Zwift Category C or D. Beacon leaders communicate via Zwift on-screen messaging (always) and/or Discord via your headset to vary the pace to allow for sprints, intervals, and optionally a mini-race towards the end of our lap or distance limited rides, with regrouping after each segment. Make as much use of drafting as you can, for more effective sprinting and intervals.

Results can be seen at the end of the ride on screen, and we publish your results on zwiftpower.com too, based on each category.

All bikes and PUs are allowed, but better not to use TT bikes (which don’t draft) on our group rides. Please add GGCC (X) to your Zwift name to allow your ride presence to be recognised, where X is your desired ride category. Categories are related to your Functional Threshold Power (FTP); use your FTP and then divide by your weight in kg, then pick the correct ride and group.

Category D: 2 W/kg to 2.5 W/kg FTP. The beacon leader will ride to 2.5w/kg pace average or below.
Category C: 2.6 W/kg to 3.2 W/kg FTP. The beacon leader will ride to 3.2w/kg pace average or below.

PLEASE NOTE: Strava data for our rides must be open (not private or hidden). Please use a heart monitor so that we can monitor correlated power and heart rate to help assure fair riding.

You can use our GGCC Discord channel to talk to each other at https://discord.gg/UDhdEQA.

Please see the GGCC Zwift page link at http://www.glasgowgreencycleclub.co.uk/ for more.

For more about specific Zwift courses for our events, see the Zwift Companion schedule, and also https://zwiftinsider.com/ where there is a wealth of information about all things Zwift.

name: Herd Classics #2 - Herd Winter Racing
description:
Herd Classics: six weeks, six different races.

This year Herd Racing is taking all their best races and putting them in one big competition.
Take on legendary Zwift courses while going on a trip down memory lane. Each week brings
us a new challenge and each week we will crown an overall and Herd Racing champion in
all categories. For the hardcore racers that will be joining us each week there is also a Herd
Classic Championship.

Week 1: The Stampede
Our ITT format, pick your best TT-bike to set the fastest time possible.

Week 2: Herd Winter Racing (also known as Herd Beginner Racing)
A mass start scratch race. Find your group and race them to the finishline.

Week 3: Herd of Mountain Goats
Climbing, lots and lots of climbing.

Week 4: Bullseye Point Race
First across the line points racing. Beat everyone to the line to score the most points.

Week 5: Climbers Gambit
Our Hill Climb event. Only your time on the climb segment counts.

Week 6: Herd Summer Racing League
It’s not really summer anymore, but we’re always in for a good FTS points race.

As a part of the trip down memory lane we’re letting everyone weigh in on the courses that
will be used. So if you want your vote to count join the Herd Racing facebook page:
https://www.facebook.com/groups/zHerdRacing

name: Spin Cycle Surprise - Power2Tri Endurance Coaching
description:
TODAY’S SESSION
Saturday sessions will largely be focused on developing the aerobic engine to support the upcoming race season.  While the intensity will generally be fairly low we will, on occasion throw some higher intensity efforts in, but overall intensity (IF) will be kept to .80 or lower.   Please note the Ride Leader generally rides outdoors on Saturdays, but if conditions don’t allow he’ll be joining you.  

ABOUT ONGOING TRAINING
The 2024 Triathlon Season is generally over for most.  Until early Spring our focus will mostly be on form/efficiency, maintenance, and prep for the upcoming season.  And, if you’ve ridden with us before, you know I’ll likely be mixing in some punchy efforts

WORKOUT DESIGNER
Dave D'Abrosca, owner and head coach of Power2Tri Endurance Coaching, creates all of these workouts and will be leading the vast majority of them. Dave is a USAT Level II Long Course and Ironman Certified Coach with experience guiding athletes through hundreds of races, from first-timers to seasoned long course triathletes, as well as XTERRA, Gravel, MTB and Runners up to Ultra distance. Dave & Team are available for questions via www.power2tri-multisport.com.  You can follow us on Instagram at https://www.instagram.com/power2tri.multisport/. Last, but not least, we are working on Team Kits, but we need to get to 100 members – if you’re interested join our Zwift Club at https://www.zwift.com/clubs/5819a1e5-7af5-437f-aab7-287c169c0cb2/home.

name: Zwift Racing League Recon Ride (DIRT)
description:
This ZRL Group Recon Ride is led by DIRT (https://www.zwift.com/clubs/e7c48063-540e-44ce-8ae5-686ebc64db05).

Zwift Racing League Group Recon Rides are the official non-competitive Group Rides. Each one is hosted/run by a participating club and will feature racing tips and tricks for the race ahead, an opportunity to ask questions relating to Zwift Racing League and to preview the full course for Tuesday’s ZRL races.

THE AIM
With experienced ride leaders and Zwifters from a reputable Zwift Club, this is your opportunity to ask questions about all things ZRL-related. You'll be able to learn useful course and team tactics and if you are new to ZRL - perhaps even find a team to race with too!

There are multiple Group Recon Rides to choose from each day at various times and each will operate at the advertised paces (pace is based on your Zwift Pace Group).

WHAT IS THE ZRL?
Introducing the spectacular Zwift Racing League (ZRL) - a turbocharged online bike racing extravaganza that's rewriting the rules of competition. With a staggering 180 community divisions, 1,800 electrifying teams, and a whopping 14,000 fierce racers per 6-week round, the ZRL stands as the undisputed heavyweight champion of online bike racing competitions worldwide.

This high-octane spectacle is masterfully orchestrated by our powerhouse partners, WTRL, who leave no stone unturned in delivering an unparalleled racing experience. But remember, this race is an invitation-only affair, so if you dare to join the ranks of speed demons and thrill-seekers, you'll need to hitch a ride with one of the esteemed existing teams. Fear not, though, for WTRL's website (www.WTRL.racing) is your portal to all the insider intel - schedule, rules, and even a team that perfectly aligns with your fiery spirit!

If you want to gather your own team, you register for the next Round of ZRL at www.wtrl.racing/zwift-racing-league/.

#zrlrecon #wtrl #zrl #dirt

description:
Welcome to the Atom Racing Team’s double draft race. All riders will start at the same time and to give a larger bunch the best chance of riding together we have added double draft. Get out the blocks fast and try to hold on to the fastest group you can. Use the draft to hold on to riders who are stronger than you normally. We will always use nice flat courses to race on but beware we may soometimes use event finishes based on distance and not traditional lap endings.
Race it or take it easy, its your choice. Either way, you’ll end the ride with the prize of a shiny new Atom Racing Team in game kit for your garage.

name: SROZ's Ride 'n Shine
description:
The Striders and Riders of Zwift's “Ride ‘n Shine” is a social ride where community comes first.

We pride ourselves on a friendly, respectful, and supportive atmosphere...perfect for those looking for a great workout and even better company.

The terrain might get a little spicy at times, but we aim for that sweet-spot average of 18–20 mph (30–32 kph).

Stick with the leader’s peloton! We’re better together...plus, you’ll save a ton of energy by tucking into that group draft.

Feeling a little gapped? Don't sweat it. We strive to have a dedicated sweeper on every ride to help pull you back into the fold.

The "Gene Autry" Philosophy: We believe in freedom! As the legend himself said, we won’t fence you in.

At the end of the day, you’re the captain of your own bike. Whether you’re pushing the pace or soaking in the scenery: ride your ride!

So come out, enjoy the virtual fresh air, and keep the faith!

eventSubgroups.name: SROZ's Ride 'n Shine (D)
eventSubgroups.description:
The Striders and Riders “Ride ‘n Shine” Casual, Social Ride is a group ride in a friendly, supportive, respectful, and enjoyable atmosphere. 🎉🚴🏻‍♂️😁

The pace may vary depending on the course, but we strive to ride and socialize with an overall average pace of approximately 18-20mph (30-32kph).  

Please be prepared to ride with the group leader’s peloton, so everyone benefits from the group draft effect. 

We will try to have a sweeper on each ride to help any rider who may want to return to the group. 

Remember, the choice is yours…ride your ride!

So, enjoy your ride, keep the faith, and become that someone!

name: GC Coaching's Amalgam
description:
GC Coaching's structured group workouts are geared towards athletes in
their base phase, so if you are looking for a Hammerfest, this isn't your
ride. These workouts are focused on building aerobic capacity and will
consist of mainly zone 2-4 riding, with some zone 5 sprinkled in at times
for good measure. We will also be mixing up the power, cadence, and
position on the bike throughout the course of the workout further challenge
your basic skills and on-bike flexibility. Come and join us!

*BIO*:
Shayne holds a bachelors degree in Health Science in Professional
Development and Advanced Patient Care, is a licensed physical therapy
assistant in Massachusetts, a USA Cycling Level 1 (expert level) certified
Coach, a USA Cycling Power Based Training Certified Coach, a Precision
Nutrition Level 1 Certified Coach, a US Military Endurance Sports (USMES)
affiliated Coach, and USA Olympic Committee Safe Sport certified.

He is the owner and head Coach of GC Coaching, Workout Content Editor at
Zwift, the creator of P2 Coached Computraining, and the creator of Zwift’s
“Build Me Up”, "Pebble Pounder", and “201: Your First 5k” Flexible Training
Plans. He has also been involved with Zwift Academy since 2019.

As an award-winning author, he has been published in Bicycling Magazine,
the TrainingPeaks blog, Zwift Insider, and hosts the Never Going Pro
podcast.

He can be reached directly through the GC Coaching website for questions
and coaching inquiries: https://gccoaching.fit/

ABOUT GROUP WORKOUTS

Zwifters line up in the starting area just like a normal event and once the event starts, workout mode begins. Everyone stays together regardless of power output. That's right, if you're outputting 100W and another Zwifter is outputting 400W you will stay in exactly the same position relative to each other. Only if you stop pedaling and fall 6 meters behind the group will the rubber-banding stop. 

We highly recommend doing one of the FTP tests as the estimated FTP can be inaccurate and make the difficulty level of the workouts too high for your current fitness level. For more info on FTP go to: https://support.zwift.com/hc/en-us/articles/210208083-What-is-FTP-and-how-is-it-used-in-Zwift

SESSION FOCUS
The focus of this, indoor, basic endurance ride, is to complete an extended
duration steady-state bout at a low intensity but with focussed blocks of

name: The BMTR Fundo
description:
The BMTR Fundo is a personal challenge that focuses on distance and/or time. Some participants may treat the event like a race, while others may take a more casual approach, with the primary goal of completing the distance.

Ultimately, this event is about getting on your bike, connecting with others, and enjoying the journey. The speed at which you ride, as well as the distance you choose, is entirely your decision!

Usually, several hundred Zwifters take part, and everyone starts at the same time, creating many opportunities to form groups and ride together along the route.

Although this event isn't considered an “official” race, results will be published for participants who choose to treat it as one.


**Categories/Groups**
In the BMTR Fundo, groups A, B, C, and D do not reflect riders' strength, ability, or fitness levels. Instead, these groups are categorized by distance. The average Watts per Kilogram (W/KG) range for each category is set to 1.0-5.0 W/KG, since each distance will include riders of varying abilities.


**Distances**
The BMTR Fundo features four distances from 26 to 100 miles, all on the same route and starting at the same time.

name: Phoenix Rising Soaring Saturday
description:
Please join us on Soaring Saturday and leave all your worries at the door to your pain cave/riding room. We welcome riders who like to go long on the weekend.

The yellow beacon will endeavor to ride at a pace of between 1.5 and 2.0 w/kg. The activation of the no-kick fence will be at the yellow beacon's discretion and used only as a guide for newer riders to let them know they're leaving the main group behind – the objective of the ride, as with all our group rides, is to share a little longer time together and enjoy the camaraderie. We employ a fab group of sweepers to accompany and/or help riders rejoin the main yellow group. We intend that no one ride alone unless they want to do so.

name: Ride to End ALZ
description:
The Ride to End ALZ South Carolina is a three-day, cross-state journey for cycling enthusiasts. Now in its 17th year, the unique Group Ride travels from beautiful Upstate South Carolina to the picturesque Charleston coast July 11-13, 2025. Riders may choose between two mileage options: The Grand Tour (257 miles) or The Half Tour (136 miles). This event is known for its incredible support along the route and camaraderie that only a multi-day ride can bring. Participants may also ride at their own pace from anywhere in our month-long Virtual Challenge. Either way, funds raised by riders benefit the Alzheimer's Association and fuel cutting-edge research targeted to change the trajectory of Alzheimer’s disease. Get all the details at alz.org/ridesc
This ride is open to everyone and all paces- the lead beacon will maintain a steady average D to C pace, and our red beacon will lead a second pace group if necessary! Our goal is to fill you in on the details of the incredible impact Ride to End ALZ has on making progress towards the research and treatment of Alzheimers through funding with the Alzheimer’s Association. In addition to the 3-day Group Ride in SC, there is also a month-long Virtual Challenge option! Join us, unlock the Ride to End ALZ kit, and learn more about how YOU can make a difference in the fight against Alzheimer’s! Join our Facebook group to get all the latest info: https://www.facebook.com/groups/alzRTR

More details at alz.org/ridesc

name: USMeS Task Force 100
description:
Welcome to USMeS Task Force 100 - Your Weekly Long-Distance Mission
100 Miles on the first Saturday of each month, 100km on all other Saturdays
Every Saturday, we go long. If you’re ready to build serious endurance, this weekly rotation keeps the challenge high and the mileage real. If you’re looking for flat terrain….sorry, but our rides didn’t get that memo 😉

100 Miles (First Saturday each month)
The big one…the Imperial Century.
Time to settle in, fuel well, and grind out 100 miles / 162 km in one steady effort.
Beacons: Two yellow beacons guiding the groups
Fence: No fence—ride your pace, push your limits

100km Ride (All other Saturdays)
The weekly grinder.
Perfect for endurance building
Ride with the group for 100 km / 62 miles at a smooth, social, consistent pace.
Beacons: Two yellow beacons guiding the groups
Fence: No fence—ride your pace, push your limits

Ride Format
✅Pure endurance—steady, smooth, social miles
✅No pressure—ride the full 100 km / 100 miles or stay as long as you want
✅No fence. Flyers are welcome to fly and everyone is encouraged to choose a sustainable group
✅No scheduled breaks, but coffee refuels every 30 minutes

Expectations
✅Respect all riders—everyone’s here for distance
✅Pace smart—whether 100 km or 100 miles, it’s endurance, not a sprint
✅Support and encourage others as the miles stack up

This is more than a ride. It’s a weekly test of stamina, patience, and love for the long haul.

Because #weareneverflat

BE LIMITLESS

#conqueringlimits #challengeaccepted #embracethesuck
www.usmilitaryesports.com

name: Alpe 65 & 85 min Pace & Chase
description:
As Zwift is a great community Torturefest Cult & Team GIANT are
collaborating to help you get stronger.

For the Torturefest rides we have added a Twist, stronger riders will be
chasing you down. Start times are set so they can catch you in the final
segments.

Pen E is the advertised paced ride with beacons
Pen D is a 85 min pace (beacons not guaranteed)
Pen C is the 50 minute pace chase (beacons not guaranteed)
Pen B is the 45 minute pace chase (beacons not guaranteed)
Pen A is the sub 40 minute pace (beacons not guaranteed)

Alpe Paced Rides

Wanna build your Alpe pace but want a wheel to follow?
Join our rides where our beacons will pace you at 4 different advertised
paces across 4 rolling weekends, 2 paces per weekend at 8am CT and 9.30 am CT.

Hold pace until ya crack, then come back again and get to extend the
cracking point.

We deliver Personal Records / Bests.

The goal is to build up to the magic sub 60 mins for Alpe, faster and
slower riders are always welcome.

This is a rolling 4-week schedule

Weekend #1
8.00 am CT 60 min pace - Torturefest Cult
9.30 am CT 75 min pace - Team GIANT

Weekend #2
8.00 am CT 65 min pace - Torturefest Cult
9.30 am CT 70 min pace - Team GIANT

Weekend #3
8.00 am CT 70 min pace - Torturefest Cult
9.30 am CT 65 min pace - Team GIANT

Weekend #4
8.00 am CT 75 min pace - Torturefest Cult
9.30 am CT 60 min pace - Team GIANT

Pro tips

1) Look at your best Alpe time on Strava, there will be a segment for
the entire
climb with average watts for the entire climb. Beating that average
watts number
by 5 watts each segment is your goal for each segment.

2) Use all the tools in the toolbox:
• Cardiovascular = Seated higher rpm
• Legs = Seated low rpm – Great for the knees!!!!
• Legs = Standing low rpm – You will crack

3) We go warm for the first 25%, a steady pace for the until 75% and push at
the end, start out too hot and you’ll suffer at the top.
